card.title: KLIN
card.text: The town of Klin lies between Kalinin and Moscow, 85 km from the capital.

Text.SourceString: The town of Klin lies between Kalinin and Moscow, 85 km from the capital.
Text.LocalizedString: The town of Klin lies between Kalinin and Moscow, 85 km from the capital.

value.value: German reinforcements are starting to arrive in the area.

SourceString.value: German reinforcements are starting to arrive in the area.

value.value: Winter is coming, it is bound to affect all participants in this battle.

SourceString.value: Winter is coming, it is bound to affect all participants in this battle.

value.value: Quantity can out-muscle quality, but only if you make it count.

SourceString.value: Quantity can out-muscle quality, but only if you make it count.

value.value: When all seems lost, don’t be afraid to charge the enemy position. Surprise can be our strongest weapon.

SourceString.value: When all seems lost, don’t be afraid to charge the enemy position. Surprise can be our strongest weapon.

value.value: The units we’ve received from the Far East front can go toe to toe with the enemy. Show the enemy what we’ve got.

SourceString.value: The units we’ve received from the Far East front can go toe to toe with the enemy. Show the enemy what we’ve got.

value.value: We must prepare for a long struggle. Every man counts!

SourceString.value: We must prepare for a long struggle. Every man counts!

value.value: The Germans are making their final push towards Moscow before the winter sets in for real. Harass them enough to keep them out of the capital.
